topic: Characteristics and Uses of Simple Machines
key_concepts: Simple machines make work easier and faster
Simple machines multiply force and speed and change direction of force
There are six basic types of simple machines
An inclined plane is a flat sloping surface used to raise heavy objects
A wedge is two inclined planes back to back with a thin edge for cutting or splitting
A wheel and axle has a circular frame revolving on a shaft or rod
A pulley uses a grooved wheel and rope to raise or lower loads
A screw is an inclined plane wrapped around a shaft with a spiral rib
A lever is a bar that turns on a fulcrum and has effort and load
